name: Sudden liquidation of savings or assets
description: Savings, investments or assets are sold abruptly, followed by withdrawal or transfer.
fp: Planned purchases, retirement or genuine need for funds.

links.name: Sudden liquidation of savings or investments to fund payments
links.ctx: Victim-side: movement of long-held savings, fixed deposits or investments into the current account followed by outbound transfers.

links.name: Sale of assets and liquidation of savings followed by withdrawal
links.ctx: Customer liquidates property, vehicle or investments and withdraws cash or moves funds abroad without an evident life event.
